name: llm
description: Routes user input to the main AI model for conversation, instruction, or complex queries. All user history is available to the AI.

forward_to_ai.description: Send a message to the AI assistant for conversation, questions, or complex tasks

message.description: The message or question to forward to the AI

message: tell me a story about space
what is the meaning of life
write a poem about the ocean
how do I learn a new language
give me advice on public speaking
